title: The Twelve-Factor App (2025)
summary: The Twelve-Factor App is a methodology for building modern software-as-a-service applications, originally authored by Heroku engineers in 2011, outlining 12 best practices for configuration management, deployment, and development workflow that ensure portability, scalability, and maintainability across different environments.
problem_solved: It solves inconsistent application design problems that arise when software behaves differently across development, staging, and production environments.
why_valuable: It provides a universal framework accepted by the industry that ensures applications can be deployed anywhere, scale effortlessly, and maintain consistency across teams and environments.
